summary: Iteration 39 frontend retest of the root SignedOutGuard (Playwright, 390x844, public URL, owner@tredi.app). All 5 requested checks PASS: (1) With /auth/me delayed 4s then 401, the path Home → More → Customers ended on /sign-in after the 401. sign-in-screen was visible, customers-screen was unmounted, no 'Kunle' text remained and localStorage was []. A web deep link to /customers with the same late 401 also ended on /sign-in. (2) A late 401 on the Home tab went to /sign-in with storage empty. (3) A fresh launch with no storage went / → /onboarding with no loop. (4) More → more-sign-out went to /sign-in and cleared every key. (5) /onboarding and /sign-in stay put without a session. sign-in-back goes to /onboarding. No page errors. NEW LOW GAP (regression from removing the (tabs) <Redirect>): the guard only fires on a signed-in → signed-out change. So, signed out: (a) browser back from /sign-in after a sign-out or a 401 now lands on the (tabs) Home shell, with an empty hero spinner, 'Could not load figures' and a working tab bar. In iteration 38 back did not return to Home. (b) A cold web deep link to /customers with no session renders the Customers screen ('Couldn't load customers', All 0) instead of going to sign-in. No data leaks in either case: the cache is empty and the API returns 401.

integration_issues.flow: Signed-out access to protected routes (web back / cold deep link)
integration_issues.issue: LOW: SignedOutGuard redirects only when `had.current` was true, meaning a user existed during this mount. The (tabs) Redirect was removed, so nothing guards protected routes when there was never a user in this mount. Reproduced: sign out from More, then browser back gives / with home-screen (empty shell, tabs usable). localStorage.clear() then goto /customers gives customers-screen with 'Couldn't load customers'. No data shown. Reference: app/_layout.tsx:25-39

action_items: LOW: In SignedOutGuard, also redirect when `ready && !user` and the current route is not public. Use useSegments(); the public routes are index (splash), onboarding, sign-in, admin/*, legal/*, help if public, and setup-business only if signed in. Keep the dismissAll + replace('/sign-in') path for a signed-in → signed-out change. This closes browser-back-to-Home after sign-out and cold deep links to /customers, /sales, etc.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx SignedOutGuard: `router` from useRouter is in the deps; it is stable in expo-router, so this is fine. canDismiss()/dismissAll() worked on web (customers-screen unmounted).
Carried over: offline-cache save() vs clearCache race, double-JSON entries, no global 401 handler in api() for tokens that expire mid-session.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 5 requested checks; 1 low follow-up gap

context_for_next_testing_agent: Late 401 repro: sign in via sign-in-email/sign-in-password/sign-in-submit, then page.route('**/api/auth/me') that sleeps 4s and fulfills 401, goto '/', tap tab-more then more-customers, wait 6s. Sign-out testID: more-sign-out (no confirm dialog). Gap repro: after sign-out, page.go_back() shows home-screen; or localStorage.clear() then goto /customers. Expo was restarted mid-run once (transient Cloudflare 502), so retry if you see 502.
rca_of_issue: The guard keys on a change in user state (had.current), not on the route. A route that mounts while already signed out (browser history entry, cold deep link) never triggers it, and the (tabs) layout no longer has its own Redirect.
